intro: Our Zenara sofa combines elegant wooden detailing with sink-in comfort. Designed for moments of pause and relaxation, it offers an inviting seat that feels thoughtfully crafted and quietly luxurious.

features.title: Enduring wooden aesthetics
features.text: Crafted with natural wood elements, the Zenara Sofa adds warmth and visual balance to your living space. Zenara’s clean lines and light presence honour traditional craftsmanship while fitting seamlessly into modern, uncluttered interiors.

features.title: Soft fabric comfort
features.text: Wrapped in premium fabric upholstery, Zenara delivers a cosy, breathable seating experience. The fabric feels gentle against the skin while offering durability for everyday use.

features.title: Supportive high-back design
features.text: The well-proportioned high backrest is designed to support your upper body without feeling bulky. It gently supports the neck and shoulders, creating a relaxed, cocoon-like seating posture that encourages you to lean back and unwind.

features.title: Thoughtfully designed for everyday living
features.text: Zenara reflects how modern homes are truly lived in. The armrests taper neatly for a refined look and widen at the elbows for added comfort. Ample ground clearance gives the sofa a light, floating feel while allowing easy cleaning underneath.
